title: From space syntax to space semantics: a behaviorally and perceptually oriented methodology for the efficient description of the geometry and topology of environments

stimuli.description: sixteen isovist polygon contours on printed cards
sixteen fictive gallery environments presented using a desktop virtual reality setup
six floor plans presented on a standard desktop computer
virtual versions of three floor plans (subsample of Figure 7d, 7e, 7f) explored actively in a VR laboratory

tables.description: Summary of hypothesized relations between basic spatial qualities and isovist measurands, including calculated methods
English translations and original German terms of rating categories used in the semantic differential

limitations: The immersive VR interface restricted the FOV and introduced viewpoint dependency and influences of exploration.
Positions offering a good overview gained some degree of centrality in VR.
Stronger influence of scale in VR, with small areas tending to be disregarded more often.

The analyses are rigorous simplifications disregarding likely relevant features such as the three-dimensional shape, surface properties, and the presence of other humans or objects and their functional meaning.
